model.groupIds: Includes parent groups, such as `claude` for a Claude Opus model.
model.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Smallest reasoning budget in tokens. Missing when the model takes no budget.
deployment.approvalRequired: The provider serves the deployment only to accounts that it has approved.
deployment.retirementDate: The date that the provider names for its shutdown. The gateway serves the deployment until 12:00 UTC on the next day. Missing until the provider announces one.
deployment.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Smallest reasoning budget in tokens. Missing when the deployment takes no budget.
deployment.weightPrecision: `fp32`, `bf16`, `fp16`, `fp8`, `fp6`, `fp4`, `nvfp4`, `mxfp4`, `int8` or `int4`, or `unknown` when the provider does not disclose it.
deployment.capabilities.systemMessages: Required by `system` or `developer` messages, or by `instructions` on Responses.
deployment.capabilities.functionCalling: Required by `function` or `custom` tools, or by `functions` on Chat Completions.
deployment.capabilities.toolChoice: Required by a `tool_choice` or `function_call` other than `auto` or `none`.
deployment.dataHandling.processingLocati: Where inference can run: a [location value](#location-values).
deployment.dataHandling.processingWithin: `processingLocation` and every place that contains it, such as `['DE', 'eu', 'europe', 'world']` for `DE`.
deployment.dataHandling.storageLocation: Where the provider can keep content at rest: a [location value](#location-values) or `none`.
deployment.dataHandling.storageWithin: `storageLocation` and every place that contains it.
deployment.dataHandling.retentionDays: Longest routine retention of content. `0` means none after the response. Missing when unknown.
deployment.dataHandling.trainingUse: The provider can train models on content. Missing when unknown.
deployment.dataHandling.zeroDataRetentio: A zero data retention commitment from the provider covers the offering. Implies storage `none`, retention `0` and no training use.
deployment.dataHandling.endToEndEncrypte: Content stays encrypted from the gateway to the provider's inference workload. Ordinary TLS to a provider endpoint is `false`.
deployment.dataHandling.tee: Inference runs inside a trusted execution environment.
deployment.dataHandling.teeVerified: Stogas verifies the measured workload itself, without relying on measurements that the provider defines. Implies `tee`.
deployment.upstream.model: The provider's name for the model.
deployment.upstream.reasoningMode: `pro` on Pro deployments and missing on others.
deployment.upstream.inferenceGeo: Where the model runs. Anthropic: the `inference_geo` that the gateway sends, `global` or `us`. Missing on models older than Claude 4.6, which take none. AWS: `global`, or the geography of a Bedrock inference profile: `us`, `eu`, `jp`, `au`, `in` or `ca`. Only `global` or `us` when Anthropic runs the model. Google Cloud: `global` or `us`, or `eu` when Google runs the model.
deployment.upstream.modelVersion: Azure: the pinned model version, such as `2026-07-09`.
deployment.upstream.hosting: Who runs the model. Azure: `azure`, `anthropic` or `fireworks`. AWS: `aws` or `anthropic`. Google Cloud: `google` or `anthropic`. `unknown` when the provider does not name who runs the model.
deployment.upstream.gpuCount: Chutes: GPUs assigned to the chute, from 1 to 8. Missing on [Standard models](/docs/providers/chutes#standard-models).
deployment.pricing.input_tokens.per_mill: Input tokens, without cache reads and writes.
deployment.pricing.cached_input_tokens.p: Input tokens read from the provider cache.
deployment.pricing.cache_write_input_tok: Cache writes without a separate price for each duration.
deployment.pricing.reasoning_tokens.per_: Missing when the deployment bills reasoning at the output price.
route.documentFormats.extensions: File extensions that the route reads from documents itself, such as `.pdf`. See [Input files](/docs/input-files).
route.documentFormats.mediaTypes: Media types that the route reads from documents itself, such as `application/pdf`.
provider.headquarteredCountry: ISO country code, such as `US`. For where inference runs, see `deployment.dataHandling.processingLocation`.
provider.credentialModes: `managed` when Stogas can serve the provider with its own account, and `byok` when [your credentials](/docs/byok) can. It does not say which one a request uses.
request.model: What the request's `model` field selects, as `kind:ID` terms in the order author, provider, route, model, group, deployment, such as `model:gpt-5.6-sol` or `provider:azure group:gpt-6`. An alias reads as its model ID. Missing when the request has none.
request.time: When the request started. The same value applies to every candidate.
request.bodyBytes: Size of the JSON body as sent, before redaction.
request.hostedTools: The [hosted tools](/docs/model-tools#hosted-tools) that the request lets the model call: `web_search`, `web_fetch` or `mcp`. Empty on Chat Completions.
